 Microsoft said it had 'collected networking logs to further investigate the source of these errors and confirm our next steps'. Mark A Johnson @ Corbis Show caption: Microsoft said it had 'collected networking logs to further … Outlook email outage affects users around the world
 Microsoft acknowledges 'service degradation'
 Cody Combs Washington November 12, 2026
 Add on Google Users of various Microsoft tools, including Outlook email, are reporting problems sending and receiving messages. 
 Microsoft's status website acknowledged the problem on Thursday afternoon. 
 "Users may be unable to connect to their mailboxes in Exchange Online through multiple connection methods," a message on the Microsoft page read in part. 
 "We’ve collected networking logs to further investigate the source of these errors and confirm our next steps." 
 According to Downdetector, which has become an online staple in monitoring internet cuts, users around the globe are also experiencing problems with Microsoft Teams, Copilot and Teams. 
 For Outlook specifically, Microsoft has classified the issue as being a "service degradation". 
 A subsequent social media post from the company explained efforts to rectify the problem. 
 "We've begun redistributing connection traffic across our broader worldwide infrastructure to help balance the load," Microsoft said. 
 As of 2:10 PM, data from Downdetector indicated that services started to recover for some users. 
 This is a developing story ...
